name: @scenoco-three/core
description: SceNoCo runtime: a component-based scene framework for Three.js (Engine, Component, registry, bundle loader)
//sideEffects: Only the built-in node modules self-register on import; everything else is pure, so bundlers can tree-shake unused node tags (and their three classes) when scenes import only the ones they use. Both dist (published) and src (monorepo source-aliased builds, e.g. examples) are listed so the registration imports survive tree-shaking either way.
